EXT.evidence: Declines a social night out (“I’ll pass on attending the hockey game… I’m going to go home”) and turns inward to think about past relationships.

AGR.evidence: Responds cynically, guessing friends just had an extra ticket and couldn’t decide who would bring a date; is labeled “glass is half empty” by a friend.

CON.evidence: Correctly recalls dates (birthday timing, October 20th) but shows no clear behavior of being organized/efficient or sloppy/careless.

NEU.evidence: Shows emotional sensitivity and rumination, choosing to go home to think about past partners on an emotionally significant date.

OPN.evidence: Not receptive to a spontaneous new outing (hockey game), preferring the familiar and cautious choice to go home and dwell on the past.
